about: A-76: the exact value (a closed form, or a decimal longer than the row prints) that a depth-audit reading recorded the SOURCE as stating, keyed by continuity/depth-audit.json entry id. Read by scripts/decimal-vs-exact.mjs, which refuses an entry whose quotation is no longer a verbatim substring of the named field of that entry, or whose closed form and decimal disagree. Candidates were extracted on 2026-10-21 MT by a reading agent from all 91 value-vs-source entries (of 93 in the store) and checked by the lead; the record is the source of each value, never this file. A value that is the reading agent's own arithmetic rather than the source's statement is not entered.
